import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Codechef {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int b = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        String[] secondLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int[] array = new int[n];
        int[] cost = new int[n];
        Arrays.fill(cost, -1);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            array[i] = Integer.parseInt(secondLine[i]);
        }
        
        int oddCount = 0, evenCount = 0, cuts = 0, totalCost = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (array[i] % 2 == 0) {
                evenCount++;
            } else {
                oddCount++;
            }
            
            if (oddCount == evenCount && i != n - 1) {
                cost[i] = Math.abs(array[i + 1] - array[i]);
                oddCount = 0;
                evenCount = 0;
            }
        }
        
        Arrays.sort(cost);
        for (int i = 0; i < cost.length; i++) {
            if (cost[i] != -1) {
                totalCost += cost[i];
                if (totalCost > b) {
                    break;
                }
                cuts++;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(cuts);
    }
}
